questions.notes: Options removed (Leichtathletik, Reiten, Biathlon). Men 2005–2015: athletics 3× (Robert Harting 2012–2014), every other sport once (biathlon: Michael Greis 2006). Counting the women's award too, biathlon (Disl, Wilhelm, Neuner 3×) and athletics would tie at 6 each, hence the men-only wording.
